title: Cylindrical body
spec: Create a new coordinate system with Euler angles set to zero degrees and a translation vector of (0.0, 0.0, 0.375) to position the origin correctly. Next, create a new face and draw a single loop on it. Within this loop, draw a circle centered at (0.0188, 0.0188) with a radius of 0.0188. Apply a scaling factor of 0.0375 to the entire sketch to adjust its size. Rotate the sketch using the Euler angles (0.0, 0.0, 0.0) and translate it using the vector (0.0, 0.0, 0.375) to align it properly in 3D space. Extrude the sketch along the normal direction by 0.1875 units and then in the opposite direction by the same distance to create a solid cylindrical body. The final dimensions of the cylindrical body will be 0.0375 units in length, 0.0375 units in width, and 0.375 units in height.

reference.label: Reference (dataset)
reference.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Define the initial coordinate system transformation
translation_vector = (0.0, 0.0, 0.375)
euler_angles = (0.0, 0.0, 0.0)

# Create the sketch
sketch = cq.Workplane("XY").center(0.0188, 0.0188).circle(0.0188)

# Extrude the sketch
extrusion = sketch.extrude(0.1875, both=True)

# Apply the coordinate system transformation
transformed_extrusion = extrusion.translate(translation_vector).rotate((0, 0, 0), (1, 0, 0), euler_angles[0]) \
    .rotate((0, 0, 0), (0, 1, 0), euler_angles[1]) \
    .rotate((0, 0, 0), (0, 0, 1), euler_angles[2])

# Final model
r = transformed_extrusion

import cadquery as cq

# Define the initial coordinate system transformation
workplane = cq.Workplane("XY").transformed(offset=(0.0188, 0.0188, 0.375))

# Create the sketch for the base of the cylinder
sketch = workplane.circle(0.0188)

# Extrude the sketch to create the cylinder
cylinder = sketch.extrude(0.1875, both=True)

# Assign the final model to 'r'
r = cylinder

import cadquery as cq

# Create the lower cylinder
lower = cq.Workplane("XY").circle(0.0188).extrude(0.1875)

# Create the upper cylinder
upper = cq.Workplane("XY").workplane(offset=0.1875).circle(0.0188).extrude(0.1875)

# Combine both cylinders into one solid
r = lower.union(upper)
